title: Reduction square component of normalized coefficient transition
statement: Let l be prime, E and L finite extensions of Q_l, ι : E \to L a Q_l-algebra map, and g : X \to Y an isomorphism of schemes on which l is invertible in every residue field. Fix completion reindexing data D,D′ and completed tensor reindexing data T,T′ satisfying their laws. For any transition data S satisfying this pure section formula, its scalar reduction transformations commute with the selected E and L reduction reindexing maps and the fixed system scalar/pullback isomorphism, at every ambient derived module K. The exact equality, including directions of inverse maps, is the attached Lean statement. The notions are those of [def-pod-completion-reindex-models], [def-pod-completion-reindex-coefficient-transition] and [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models].

proof.text: Represent an ambient derived module by a good K-flat complex. Use the selected quotient-generator and quotient-transition laws of D and D′ to identify its two reduction reindexing maps degreewise. The pure tensor formula for S.ordinary identifies the two routes on scalar-unit quotient generators; balancedness extends the equality to all tensors and sheafification extends it to sections. The cochain scalar counit comparison is normalized by this same tensor formula. The selected scalar models are normalized on the primitive quotient complex, so their realization maps give the same comparison after the chosen Roos realization. Descend the equality through the good-complex localization to K; substituting the definition of podScalarReduction and its whole-system counit gives exactly the displayed equation. This uses the selected D,D′ data, rather than replacing them by newly chosen comparisons.

theorem podReindexingTensorCoefficientTransition_reduction
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (l : Y.residueField y)]
    (D : PodCompletionReindex l E g) (hD : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l E g D)
    (T : PodCompletedTensorReindex l E g D)
    (hT : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l E g D T)
    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra ℚ_[l] L] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] L]
    (ι : E →ₐ[ℚ_[l]] L)
    (D' : PodCompletionReindex l L g) (hD' : PodCompletionReindex.Laws l L g D')
    (T' : PodCompletedTensorReindex l L g D')
    (hT' : PodCompletedTensorReindex.Laws l L g D' T')
    (S : PodReindexCoefficientTransition l E L ι g D D')
    (hpure : ∀ (M : scalarReductionSource l E Y) (U : X.ProEt)
      (x : M.val.obj (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)))
      (a : (completedIntegralCoefficientSheafUnrestricted l L Y).obj.obj
        (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U))),
      (S.ordinary.hom.app M).val.app (op U)
          (integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι X
            ((isoReductionIntegralInverse l E g).obj M) (op U)
            ((isoReductionCompletedMap l L g).hom.hom.app (op U) a) x) =
        integralOrdinaryTensorSection l E L ι Y M
          (op ((proEtaleIsoPostcompose g).obj U)) a x) :
    ∀ K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E Y),
      (podScalarReduction l E L ι X D'.targetRoos S.target).app
          ((podOrdinaryReindex l E g).obj K) ≫
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι X).map
          (D.reduction.inv.app K) ≫
        (integralComparisonSystemScalarPullback l E L ι g).hom.app
          ((podReindexCalculus l E Y).reduction.obj K) =
      (podReindexCalculus l L X).reduction.map
          ((S.derived l E L ι g D D').hom.app K) ≫
        D'.reduction.inv.app
          ((integralOrdinaryDerivedScalar l E L ι Y).obj K) ≫
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequencePullback l L g).map
          ((podScalarReduction l E L ι Y D'.sourceRoos S.source).app K)
